snippet.title: PNEUMA Announcement Trailer: Sci-Fi Paranormal Investigation Game
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM NOW 💥 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4171930/PNEUMA/

In PNEUMA, you are a disposable asset of the Special Pneuma Investigation Division (S.P.I.D). Your contract is simple: board the distressed ship, investigate what haunts it and exile the entity.

A DESOLATE PLACE IN INFINITE SPACE:

Tactical Co-op: Play with up to 4 players. Cooperation is key - until the possession starts.

Tools of the Trade: Master tools like the Dark Matter Field Detector, Lidar Scanner, and Gravity Sensor to track what cannot be seen.

Avoid Possession: If the entity catches you, the hunt isn't over. Turn on your friends, terrorize your crew, the entity strikes from the shadows to ensure no one leaves the ship alive.

Atmospheric Dread: Explore broken, bloody spaceships with dynamic lighting and high-fidelity 3D audio designed to keep you on edge.

Will you succeed in your investigation, or become a part of the ship's history?

JOIN THE INVESTIGATION:

Join our mailing list: https://forms.gle/1aPPz9W56CoRCEwQ9

Tiktok:   / gravity_grid_studios  

Twitter/X: https://x.com/Gravity_Grid
